source: Project owner confirmation 25/11/2026, DC-SOUL-01/02, DC-TRAP-02, DC-PACK-KEEP, 4/4 A. Conditions in Articles 1–6 retained.

decisions.rule: Only specifically designated damage skills may attempt public-dead seats. Valid attempts consume the skill's applicable resource or usage. Truly dead targets do not incur a new death. Secret survivors take normal damage with valid defenses. No target/receipt/error oracle. No blanket expansion.
scope: existing QA [8,23,25,36], official.8.night-kill only; one nightly use, no finite ammo
notAuthorized: all finite-cost blind damage skills including #23 and #36 until explicitly designated
decisions.conflict: No contradiction for existing #8 QA. Complete designated list not established by owner text or skill registry.

decisions.rule: A valid #23 shot at a village player consumes one bullet and applies normal damage subject to protections, death-chain and victory. Do not expose faction before authorized resolution. No duplicate charge on retry/restart. Other firing rights unchanged.
scope: QA [8,23,25,36] with persisted WV-DC-2026-11-25-A policy; public-living non-self target, existing two-bullet/night-only restriction
decisions.conflict: #23 describes goal of eliminating wolves and third factions, not an explicit friendly-fire immunity; owner choice settles mistaken targeting. QD-01 includes dead village winners.

decisions.rule: A valid trapped #26 revival fails; original deceased state remains. Spend one revival and one trap at shared NightActionGroup closure. Invalid commands do not trigger; no synthetic damage/death/revival. No duplicate consumption. Independent effects still resolve.
scope: QA [8,10,25,26], persisted WV-DC-2026-11-25-A policy; valid prior or same-night trap with placement priority 50, revival priority 200
decisions.conflict: VH73 supersedes original village-only revival and VH76 excludes 46/47/53. BB-04 concerns protection/rescue, not revival of a deceased player; DC-TRAP-02 establishes specific failure semantics.

decisions.rule: Before lock permanently revoke latest now-invalid choice, keep all still-valid choices, require explicit replacement, no fallback or timeout; do not change a legally committed attack. KEEP retains only a still-valid choice. Hide secret reason in authorized projection.
scope: candidate lockPack state-level logic, persisted revoked selection revisions; NOT activated in live pack QA
decisions.conflict: No conflict with KEEP; a secretly revoked valid submission can alter phase progression vs a still-valid selection. Observable lock/wait oracle is unresolved. No new public reason is authorized.
